title: Samples To Frame
text: Convert sample stream to frame-based data, 2 inputs, 3 outputs; {Input size} sets the number of values representing each sample, {Frame search window} sets the number of input cycles to buffer, {Output size} sets the maximum samples per frame, {Compose output from interleaved input samples} sets the order of output samples relative to input and {Enable frame length output port} sets the output number of valid samples. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ctrl
ports.summary: Control signals accompanying sample stream samplecontrol bus

ports.name: frame
ports.summary: Frame of output samples column vector

ports.name: len
ports.summary: Number of valid samples in output frame integer

params.name: Input size
params.values: Number of values representing each sample 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Frame search window
params.values: Number of input cycles to buffer 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output size
params.values: Maximum samples per frame 1024 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Compose output from interleaved input samples
params.values: Order of output samples relative to input order off (default) | on
